notes.title: OLD SKOOL RACER APRIL UPDATE
notes.notes:
April 17th, 2024, Release Notes
Yes, believe it or not, we are still working on the game! This will be the first of the many updates planned for this year.
1.The first two complete seasons with car and speedboat racing
2.Both singleplayer and 4 player multiplayer
3.Time Trial, Quick Race and Championship in Singleplayer
4.All customisation options working now in car and boat garage
5.A complete Winner’s Island with both day and night versions
6.New visual effects such as particles, raytracing GI
7.Support for DLSS 3 and FSR 2

notes.title: OLD SKOOL RACER UPDATE MAY 2022
notes.notes:
Welcome to our first update for 2022. 
Thankfully, all the team members survived the COVID waves (with a few hospital visits) and are hard at work on OSR again. Hopefully, this will be the year that the game goes gold. 
Here is a summary of the content in this update:
a)	New car levels: New York, Mexico
b)	Updated Egypt level
c)	Singleplayer boat racing in Venice and London
d)	Multiplayer car racing
e)	Updated Winner’s Island with trophies and feature unlock menu
f)	Updated car garage with new photoreal cars
g)	New boat garage
h)	New sound effects in all levels

notes.title: BUG FIXES
notes.notes:

b) Amsterdam level not loading

notes.title: DECEMBER 2021 UPDATE
notes.notes:
Dear friends,
Oh, what a year it has been! 2021 turned out to be quite a rollercoaster. 
Like many around the world, COVID did not spare the Karma Play team as well. One of our team members came down with the virus and needed hospitalisation. Another team member got afflicted by another virus. Naturally, these events had a significant impact on a small team like ours.
But between all this, we did manage to make some progress since the last update. Not as much as we hoped, but considering the rollercoaster year, it is almost a Christmas miracle. So, here are the updates. 
Please do keep in mind that all levels, features are still work in progress and none of the levels are optimised for performance yet. 
a)	A completely new Winner’s Island and mansion
b)	10 cars in the garage with arcade car physics
c)	6 car racing levels (some are a little bit closer to the final version than others)
d)	Basic multiplayer in all levels
Wishing all of you a great 2022.
